_comment: The commissioner's rulings on transactions. 'void' on an 'add' (no kind, or kind 'void'): it does not count against the weekly add budget and is not listed as an add; rosters are untouched (ROSTERS.json follows Yahoo). kind 'effective_date' on an 'add': the player is not on that manager's roster for any day before 'effective' (every reader of LINEUPS/PLAYERLOG drops those rows at load time; the logs are never rewritten) and the add counts in the fantasy week containing 'effective'. kind 'claim_week' on an 'add' (LEAGUE_RULES rule 7): the add was claimed in the group chat in fantasy week 'claim_week' and applied in Yahoo on 'transaction_date' in a later week's Monday window; it counts against claim_week's add budget, not the budget of its Yahoo week, and nothing else changes (rosters, logs and the join date follow Yahoo); it is listed in its Yahoo week's waivers file marked '(week N claim)'. claim_week must be earlier than the week of transaction_date. One add carries at most one ruling. Which week an add counts in is decided by transaction_rulings.add_budget_week alone; pre-season adds count nowhere (Nick, 10-31). A ruling that matches no transaction raises, and so does an effective date that would drop a started game. Read by scripts/sync_transactions.py, every reader of waivers_week{N}.txt and every reader of the logs (modules/transaction_rulings.py).

rulings.reason: Benton had already claimed Paul George in the group chat during week 1; the claim had not been applied yet. Garrett's add (dropped the same day) is void and his week-2 move count was set from 3 to 2.

Added late Sunday 10-25 after every game had finished; counted as a week 2 move. transaction_date corrected 2026-10-31 from 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-25: Yahoo stamped the add Sun 10-25 22:40 Pacific, and since 708afd7 the sync dates transactions on the league clock (Pacific), not the machine clock (the week 2 sync ran on UTC, where it was 10-26 05:40).

Added Sun 10-25 22:35 Pacific and dropped five minutes later for Zach LaVine. Nick, 10-31: "that was a mistake and I allowed the void, so the Franz Wagner add never happened effectively." Counts in no week's add budget and is not listed.
